verdict.rationale: Cursor is a closed-source, cloud-backed product; the only self-hosting option documented is 'Self-Hosted Machines' for Cloud Agent tool execution, but even there 'Cursor runs the agent loop, inference, and planning' on Cursor's servers — the core product (IDE, agent orchestration, model inference) cannot be self-hosted. No evidence of an open-source release or fully self-hostable deployment.
